title: CXS Outcome v0.1.1
description: The scored result of a trial. Kept separate from the Trial so a run can be re-scored without re-calling the model, which is what makes cached results reusable across scorers.

verdict.description: Added in CXS 0.1.1, because `passed` is a boolean and cannot carry a third state. Optional and additive: binary scorers may keep emitting `passed` alone. Where both appear they must agree. A producer that can generate 'inconclusive' or 'error' MUST emit `verdict` and MUST omit `passed` for those two values, so a reader that only understands `passed` skips the record instead of misreading it as a failure.

allOf.$comment: passed and verdict must agree where both are present.
An unresolved verdict has no honest binary or numeric reading, so neither field may accompany it.
